_about: Config for the career-engine pipeline. 'database_backend' names your tracker (default 'notion'). REQUIRED keys (a run stops without them): output_folder, cv_template, and database_id (only when a database backend is configured). EVERY other key is OPTIONAL — pipelines run without it and a config-health notice lists what is empty or missing, so an older config never breaks. Legacy names (notion_database_id, notion_needs_editing_view_url, notion_property, idea_bank.notion_database_id, idea_bank.notion_page_url) are still read for backward compatibility; prefer the database_* names.

idea_bank.description: Database for idea capture (mind-dump pipeline). Set database_id to your Ideas database ID.

linkedin_post.description: LinkedIn post writing pipeline config. default_format_mix is advisory for the content orchestrator.

content_calendar.description: Content calendar orchestrator config. default_batch_size is the number of posts per orchestrator run.
